label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from request.getHeader("Referer") flows directly to response.getWriter().println() without proper escaping. The StringBuilder.replace() operation only modifies the last character (param.length()-1 to param.length()), providing no meaningful XSS prevention. X-XSS-Protection header is explicitly disabled ("0").

evidence.note: User input from Referer header flows through URL decode then directly to response.getWriter().println()
